reports.title: Sirius XM Holdings Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Raises Full-Year Financial Guidance

lines: •SiriusXM raises full year 2026 guidance by $25 million for Revenue, Adjusted EBITDA and Free Cash Flow2

SiriusXM raised its full-year 2026 financial guidance for the second consecutive quarter, increasing each of its three key financial metrics by $25 million, reflecting continued operating momentum, improved profitability and strong cash flow generation.
